review.why: Writes B2B cold emails, follow-ups and cadences, and sets the deliverability basics: secondary domains, verified lists, no open tracking.
review.summary: Peer-voice emails with one low-friction ask, short internal-looking subject lines and three to five follow-ups that each add something new. A pre-send checklist covers secondary domains, authentication, warm-up, list verification, bounce limits, an opt-out line and a postal address. It extends to LinkedIn and multichannel cadences and to classifying replies.
